caption: Hint Feature
content:
If you're not sure how to apply the techniques in the "Tips" guide to an actual puzzle, you can use the @b{Hint feature}.
When enabled, it provides step-by-step hints on how to solve each Area logically—either by completing it or by proving that it cannot be completed.

content.content:
We recommend using the Hint feature @b{only when you're completely stuck and can't progress}, and viewing @b{only as much as you need}.
If you rely on hints to progress without learning how to solve the puzzles yourself, you may struggle later on.
